sentences.en: Today, the nasty battle between the Biden administration and Facebook over who is responsible for misinformation about the COVID-19 vaccine.
sentences.zh: 今天，拜登政府与脸书之间关于谁该为新冠疫苗虚假信息负责的激烈骂战。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Cecilia Kong, about who's right and what's at stake.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事塞西莉亚·孔讨论了谁是对的以及其中的利害关系。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月20日星期二。

sentences.en: Cecilia, can you describe how this fight between the White
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚，你能描述一下白宫

sentences.en: House and Facebook has played out over the past few days?
sentences.zh: 与脸书之间的这场争端在过去几天是如何演变的吗？

sentences.en: Over the last few days, there's been a remarkable set of comments by the Biden administration and the White House that really
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，拜登政府和白宫发表了一系列引人注目的言论，它们确实

sentences.en: place blame at social media companies like Facebook for being the biggest impediment to solving the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 将解决大流行病的最大障碍归咎于脸书等社交媒体公司。

sentences.en: Hello, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你们好吗？

sentences.en: It started with the Surgeon General on Thursday making a statement at the White House.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于周四卫生局长在白宫发表的声明。

sentences.en: Today, I issued a Surgeon General's advisory on the dangers of health misinformation.
sentences.zh: 今天，我发布了一份关于健康虚假信息危害的卫生局长公告。

sentences.en: For the first time, issuing a public warning that misinformation related to COVID-19
sentences.zh: 这是第一次发出公开警告，称与新冠

sentences.en: vaccines was really preventing people from getting the vaccine and really one of the biggest obstacles to the White House's efforts.
sentences.zh: 疫苗相关的虚假信息确实在阻碍人们接种疫苗，这确实是白宫努力的最大障碍之一。

sentences.en: The truth is that misinformation takes away our freedom to make informed decisions about our health and the health of our loved ones.
sentences.zh: 事实是，虚假信息剥夺了我们对自身健康以及所爱之人健康做出知情决定的自由。

sentences.en: He said that the threats often come from what we eat, drink, and smoke.
sentences.zh: 他说，这些威胁往往来自我们吃、喝和吸烟的东西。

sentences.en: Today, we live in a world where misinformation poses an imminent and insidious threat to our nation's health.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们生活在一个虚假信息对国家健康构成迫在眉睫且潜移默化威胁的世界里。

sentences.en: We must confront misinformation as a nation.
sentences.zh: 我们必须作为一个国家来对抗虚假信息。

sentences.en: Every one of us has the power and the responsibility to make a difference in this fight.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有力量和责任在这场斗争中发挥作用。

sentences.en: Lives are depending on it.
sentences.zh: 生命悬于一线。

sentences.en: So he's saying that online misinformation about the COVID-19 vaccine is literally a public health crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以他是说，关于新冠疫苗的网络虚假信息简直是一场公共卫生危机。

sentences.en: He is for the first time saying that speech and comments that are made on the internet have hopped over into real life and have caused real-world harm.
sentences.zh: 他首次表示，在互联网上发表的言论和评论已经渗透到现实生活中，并造成了现实世界的伤害。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: And I'll turn it to Jen.
sentences.zh: 接下来我交给詹。

sentences.en: And then right after the Surgeon General, Jen Psaki, the White House press secretary, doubles down on his message.
sentences.zh: 就在卫生局长发言后不久，白宫新闻秘书珍·普萨基再次强调了他的观点。

sentences.en: There are also proposed changes that we have made to social media platforms, including Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们还对包括脸书在内的社交媒体平台提出了修改建议。

sentences.en: And she really homes in on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 她确实把矛头直指脸书。

sentences.en: She said that Facebook has been a leading cause of this misinformation.
sentences.zh: 她说脸书一直是这种虚假信息的主要起因。

sentences.en: Facebook should provide publicly and transparently data on the reach of COVID-19,
sentences.zh: 脸书应该公开透明地提供关于新冠传播范围的数据，

sentences.en: COVID vaccine misinformation.
sentences.zh: 以及新冠疫苗虚假信息的数据。

sentences.en: And she said that the company owes it to the public to be transparent about how much misinformation is on the site, how it's spreading, and how much it's being engaged with.
sentences.zh: 并且她说，公司有责任向公众公开，网站上有多少虚假信息、它们是如何传播的以及互动量有多大。

sentences.en: Second, we have recommended, proposed that they create a robust enforcement strategy that bridges
sentences.zh: 其次，我们建议并提议他们建立一个强有力的执行策略，连接

sentences.en: She pointed to the fact that the White House has had to repeatedly flag misinformation around the
sentences.zh: 她指出，白宫不得不反复向脸书标记关于

sentences.en: coronavirus vaccines to Facebook, and that the company takes too long to respond to this misinformation that's spreading so rapidly.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒疫苗的虚假信息，而该公司对这种迅速蔓延的虚假信息反应太慢。

sentences.en: Finally, we have proposed they promote quality information sources in their feed algorithm.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们建议他们在信息流算法中推广优质信息源。

sentences.en: She really also focused, Michael, on the algorithms that allow the company to spread misinformation so rapidly compared to any other media platforMs.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，她确实还将焦点放在了算法上，正是这些算法让该公司能够比任何其他媒体平台更快地传播虚假信息。

sentences.en: In this case, that's certainly an area that would have an impact.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这肯定是一个会产生影响的领域。

sentences.en: So she made a public call for Facebook to do better.
sentences.zh: 因此，她公开呼吁脸书做得更好。

sentences.en: Thanks, everyone.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: And then the next day, President Biden, just before he got on Marine One to Camp David, was asked by a reporter On COVID misinformation.
sentences.zh: 第二天，拜登总统在登上“海军陆战队一号”前往戴维营之前，被记者问及新冠虚假信息。

sentences.en: about what his message to social media companies would be, like Facebook.
sentences.zh: 关于他对脸书等社交媒体公司的信息会是什么。

sentences.en: They're killing people.
sentences.zh: 他们在杀人。

sentences.en: And the president said, they're killing people.
sentences.zh: 总统说，他们在杀人。

sentences.en: The only pandemic we have is among the unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我们现在唯一的流行病存在于未接种疫苗的人群中。

sentences.en: And they're killing people.
sentences.zh: 而他们在杀人。

sentences.en: It was really a stunning statement.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个令人震惊的声明。

sentences.en: And the first time that I have heard, and the public has heard, such a direct line that the administration was drawing between these social media platforms and their problems and
sentences.zh: 这也是我以及公众第一次听到行政当局在这些社交媒体平台及其在解决大流行病时遇到的问题和

sentences.en: their challenges when it comes to solving the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 挑战之间划出如此直接的联系。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He seems to be saying, and this overall very highly coordinated effort by the White House
sentences.zh: 他似乎在说，白宫这一整体高度协调的行动

sentences.en: seems to be saying, that companies like Facebook, in a sense, have blood on their hands when it
sentences.zh: 似乎在说，由于脸书承载了虚假信息，导致美国人不愿接种新冠疫苗，从某种意义上说，

sentences.en: comes to Americans being unwilling to take the COVID-19 vaccine because of the misinformation that they hoSt.
sentences.zh: 这些公司手上沾满了鲜血。

sentences.en: It was an extraordinary statement, and Facebook immediately pushed back.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非同寻常的声明，脸书随即进行了反击。

sentences.en: In a blog post, Facebook slammed the administration's position.
sentences.zh: 在博客文章中，脸书猛烈抨击了政府的立场。

sentences.en: It's perhaps not surprising that Facebook is not happy about having that message come out of the White House and what that's...
sentences.zh: 脸书对白宫传出这种信息以及由此带来的影响感到不高兴，这或许并不令人意外……

sentences.en: They said, no, we are absolutely not killing people.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不，我们绝对没有杀人。

sentences.en: And that's unfair.
sentences.zh: 这不公平。

sentences.en: They said, in fact, we've tried to use our platform to help save lives.
sentences.zh: 他们说，事实上，我们一直在利用我们的平台来帮助拯救生命。

sentences.en: We put a ton of effort into putting out authentic and correct information about coronavirus vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我们花大量精力发布关于冠状病毒疫苗的真实和正确的信息。

sentences.en: And you, the Biden administration, Facebook was saying, are scapegoating us because it looks like you're not going to meet your vaccine goals.
sentences.zh: 脸书表示，你们拜登政府是在把我们当替罪羊，因为看起来你们无法实现疫苗接种目标。

sentences.en: And that's not our fault at Facebook.
sentences.zh: 这在脸书不是我们的错。

sentences.en: So stop finger pointing.
sentences.zh: 所以不要指指点点。

sentences.en: And that's true, right?
sentences.zh: 事实确实如此，对吧？

sentences.en: The administration has missed its vaccination targets.
sentences.zh: 政府没有达到其疫苗接种目标。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The administration wanted to get 70% of all adults vaccinated by July 4th, and they did not meet that target.
sentences.zh: 政府原本希望在7月4日之前让70%的成年人接种疫苗，但他们没有达到这个目标。

sentences.en: So, Cecilia, who is right here?
sentences.zh: 那么，塞西莉亚，谁是对的？

sentences.en: Facebook or the White House?
sentences.zh: 脸书还是白宫？

sentences.en: I mean, it's hard to say, Michael, because there's evidence that both sides are right and a little bit wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很难说，迈克尔，因为有证据表明双方都有对的地方，也有点不对。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, let's walk through this and start with this White House claim and what in that claim feels legitimate when it comes to Facebook allowing content that has created vaccine
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们来梳理一下，从白宫的这种说法开始，在脸书允许产生疫苗犹豫的内容这一点上，

sentences.en: hesitancy.
sentences.zh: 这种说法有什么合理之处？

sentences.zh: 这种说法背后的证据是什么？

sentences.en: Well, first, they're seeing it on the ground.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，他们在实地看到了这种情况。

sentences.en: The White House is saying that when they go out and ask Americans why they're hesitant about getting the vaccine, they hear stories like the vaccine will cause autism or will harm
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，当他们去询问美国人为什么对接种疫苗犹豫不决时，他们听到诸如疫苗会导致自闭症或伤害

sentences.en: pregnant women and their unborn babies, that the vaccine could even lead to Bill Gates implanting a microchip into individuals.
sentences.zh: 孕妇及其未出生的婴儿，甚至疫苗可能导致比尔·盖茨将微芯片植入个人体内之类的小道消息。

sentences.en: These are all false stories.
sentences.zh: 这些全都是假消息。

sentences.en: And the White House asks, where are you hearing these things?
sentences.zh: 白宫质问，你们是从哪里听到这些事情的？

sentences.en: And they almost always point to Facebook.
sentences.zh: 而他们几乎总是指向脸书。

sentences.en: And that's led the White House to look at a study by the Center for Countering Digital Hate
sentences.zh: 这促使白宫查看了打击数字仇恨中心的一项研究，

sentences.zh: 该研究调查了12个人，被称为“虚假信息十二人组”，他们在社交媒体上制造了65%的反疫苗虚假信息。

sentences.en: 12 people producing 65 percent of all the misinformation on social media around COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 12个人制造了社交媒体上关于新冠肺炎的所有虚假信息的65%。

sentences.en: That's an extraordinary impact of a small group of people.
sentences.zh: 一小群人产生了非凡的影响。

sentences.en: They're super spreaders is how they're being viewed.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为超级传播者。

sentences.en: Hey, everybody.

sentences.en: It's Robert F.
sentences.zh: 我是罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: here.

sentences.en: He is well known for his positions against taking vaccines.

sentences.en: I cannot tell you how happy I am to be able to have this opportunity to talk to thousands of citizens in 15 countries.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你我有多高兴能有这个机会与15个国家的数千名公民交谈。

sentences.en: In one post in February, he really warned that the vaccine could be detrimental to pregnant women.

sentences.en: Now, what he was claiming is not backed by any medical or scientific research.
sentences.zh: 现在，他所声称的并没有任何医学或科学研究的支持。

sentences.en: That particular post was eventually flagged as false by Facebook and Instagram, but it was also viewed tens of thousands of times.
sentences.zh: 这篇特定的帖子最终被脸书和 Instagram 标记为虚假信息，但它也被观看勒数万次。

sentences.en: Doesn't it seem like you're waking me up out of a dream or more accurately, like a nightmare?
sentences.zh: 难道不觉得你把我从梦中唤醒了吗，或者更准确地说，像是一场噩梦？

sentences.en: This is just some type of dystopian or willian nightmares, absolutely surreal.

sentences.en: Absolutely.

sentences.zh: 像充满活力的、由美丽的50年历史藏品组成的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《The Reframers》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》App并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Cecilia, talk us through Facebook's arguments and the evidence behind them that it has done a lot to counter vaccine misinformation.
sentences.zh: 那么塞西莉亚，请跟我们聊聊脸书的论点以及背后的证据，即它为反击疫苗虚假信息做了很多工作。

sentences.en: What have they done?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, what Facebook has really focused on is what I describe as offense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，脸书真正关注的是我所描述的进攻。

sentences.en: They have done a lot to promote authentic information and to try to get people to go out and get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他们做了很多工作来推广真实信息，并试图让人门走出去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: I mean, for example, I'm looking right now at my Facebook app and I see the COVID-19
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，举个例子，我刚刚打开我的Facebook应用，看到了COVID-19

sentences.en: Information Center.
sentences.zh: 信息中心。

sentences.en: It tells me, looking for COVID-19 vaccine information, find answers to common questions.
sentences.zh: 它告诉我，寻找COVID-19疫苗信息，查找常见问题的答案。

sentences.en: So I get a Q&A.
sentences.zh: 所以我得到了一个问答。

sentences.en: It also tells me, go to this place in my neighborhood, in my vicinity, where I can find vaccines available.
sentences.zh: 它还告诉我，去我附近、我周围的这个地方，在那里我可以找到可用的疫苗。

sentences.en: This information appears as like a pop-up box.
sentences.zh: 这些信息就像一个弹出窗口一样出现。

sentences.en: So it's right there when you open your app and you're the website.
sentences.zh: 所以当你打开你的应用、访问网站时，它就在那里。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of proactive, offensive measure that they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们正在采取的那种主动的、进攻性的措施。

sentences.en: So this is Facebook literally taking people by the hand and showing them how to get a vaccine,
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是Facebook手把手地带人们了解如何接种疫苗，

sentences.en: which they would argue is the most powerful way to counter bad information, even on Facebook, that raises doubts about the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们会认为，这是反击虚假信息的最有力方式，即使是在Facebook上那些对疫苗产生怀疑的信息。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're saying we are actually taking the extra measures to try to help with this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们是在说，我们确实在采取额外的措施来努力应对这场大流行。

sentences.en: But I would also note that this is so core to Facebook's philosophy on content and speech, which is that good information can drown out bad information.
sentences.zh: 但我也想指出，这正是Facebook关于内容和言论哲学的核心所在，也就是好信息可以压倒坏信息。

sentences.en: And that's the strategy they're taking here.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们在这里采取的策略。

sentences.en: Another thing they do is they put labels related to the vaccine that gives people a little bit more information promoting the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们做的另一件事是，他们在疫苗相关内容上添加标签，为人们提供更多推广疫苗的信息。

sentences.en: So if you put in your status update, I just got the vaccine and my arm is sore,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在状态更新中说，我刚打了疫苗，我的胳膊很酸，

sentences.en: automatically the company's machine learning will see that language that you've mentioned the vaccine, and they'll attach a label to that particular status update.
sentences.zh: 该公司的机器学习功能会自动识别到你提到了疫苗，并会在该特定状态更新上附加一个标签。

sentences.en: And that label will read something like, COVID-19 vaccines go through many tests for safety and effectiveness before they're approved.
sentences.zh: 该标签的内容大致是：COVID-19疫苗在获批之前要经过多项安全性和有效性测试。

sentences.en: See the World Health Organization and get vaccine information.
sentences.zh: 请参阅世界卫生组织获取疫苗信息。

sentences.en: Oh, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，有意思。

sentences.en: So basically, Facebook is spotting what might be interpreted as skepticism or critique of
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，Facebook在发现可能被解读为对疫苗持怀疑态度或批评态度的内容，

sentences.en: the vaccine, and it's producing a message that would encourage somebody to take the vaccine by saying, hey, this has been tested, this is safe.
sentences.zh: 然后它会生成一条信息，通过说“嘿，这已经测试过了，这是安全的”，来鼓励人们接种疫苗。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And they go a step further in other cases in that they say they've taken down straight out misinformation.
sentences.zh: 在其他情况下，他们甚至更进一步，表示已经删除了直接的虚假信息。

sentences.en: They say that they've taken down 18 million pieces of content that promote false conspiracy theories and news related to the vaccine and COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，已经删除了1800万条宣扬与疫苗和COVID-19相关的虚假阴谋论和新闻的内容。

sentences.en: That sounds like a lot to have taken down 18 million, but relative to the viewership of misinformation, is that actually meaningful?
sentences.zh: 删除了1800万条听起来很多，但相对于虚假信息的浏览量来说，这真的有意义吗？

sentences.en: This is really key, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这非常关键，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We don't know what the whole pool of misinformation is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道虚假信息的全部池子有多大。

sentences.en: We don't know what that denominator is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道那个分母是多少。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So 18 million takedowns of how many?
sentences.zh: 所以，这1800万次的删除是针对多少基数而言的？

sentences.en: And that's actually one of the things that's really frustrating the White House right now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这也是目前让白宫感到非常沮丧的事情之一。

sentences.en: They want to know what that denominator is.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道那个分母是什么。

sentences.en: So they want to know how big is the reservoir of misinformation on Facebook related to the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想知道Facebook上与疫苗相关的虚假信息库究竟有多大。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So that they can measure what it means when Facebook says we've taken down 18 million out of?
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能衡量，当Facebook说我们从总数中删除了1800万条时，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: How many?
sentences.zh: 总数是多少？

sentences.en: And further, how many people have viewed that content?
sentences.zh: 此外，有多少人看过这些内容？

sentences.en: How many people have liked it?
sentences.zh: 有多少人点赞了？

sentences.en: How many people have shared it?
sentences.zh: 有多少人分享了？

sentences.en: That's really key to understanding engagement and reach.
sentences.zh: 这对于理解参与度和覆盖面至关重要。

sentences.en: Is it fair to say, Cecilia, that Facebook has taken down some of the individual posts of the disinformation dozen, but still let them continue to post?
sentences.zh: 西莉亚，这样说公平吗：Facebook删除了“反疫苗十二人组”的一些个人帖子，但仍让他们继续发帖？

sentences.en: Is that how this works?
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的吗？

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: They've taken down not only posts, but they've taken down some pages and some groups associated with the disinformation dozen.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅删除了帖子，还删除了与“反疫苗十二人组”相关的一些主页和群组。

sentences.en: But those individuals are able to run other groups, other pages, and their accounts remain active.
sentences.zh: 但这些人仍然能够运营其他群组、其他主页，他们的账号依然处于活跃状态。

sentences.en: So this would seem to be Facebook acknowledging, in a way, that there is a problem, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎表明Facebook在某种程度上承认了问题的存在，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, if they're taking down 18 million individual posts, that would seem to be a form of conceding that vaccine misinformation is very present on the platform.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他们删除了1800万条单独的帖子，这似乎就是一种承认：疫苗虚假信息在该平台上非常普遍。

sentences.en: They are absolutely aware that this is a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 他们完全意识到这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: They are really struggling, however, with how they can actually police misinformation and to also protect different point of views.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们在如何实际监管虚假信息以及同时保护不同观点方面，确实感到了挣扎。

sentences.en: At the heart of this is something that Facebook has struggled with for years, which is what
sentences.zh: 这核心触及了Facebook多年来一直在挣扎的一个问题，那就是

sentences.en: kind of speech they will allow on the platform and what kind of speech could eventually be so harmful that it should be taken down.
sentences.zh: 他们究竟允许平台上存在什么样的言论，以及什么样的言论最终会具有如此大的危害性以至于应当被删除。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And they have to negotiate that every time they look at a post that's skeptical of the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 每当他们看到对疫苗持怀疑态度的帖子时，他们都必须权衡这一点。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of gray area.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多灰色地带。

sentences.en: There's sometimes satire.
sentences.zh: 有时是讽刺。

sentences.en: There's sometimes just commentary.
sentences.zh: 有时只是评论。

sentences.en: And conservative figures in Washington, lawmakers as well as media figures, really are watching this very closely.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的保守派人士，包括国会议员和媒体人物，都在非常密切地关注此事。

sentences.en: And they're criticizing Facebook for being too strict on their takedown policies.
sentences.zh: 他们在批评Facebook的删除政策过于严厉。

sentences.en: They say that people should be able to express different points of views as related to the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们认为人们应该能够表达与疫苗相关的不同观点。

sentences.en: There are many Republicans who are not vaccinated right now.
sentences.zh: 现在有许多共和党人没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And there are many media figures on TV who say that these companies should not be in the business of censorship.
sentences.zh: 电视上也有很多媒体人物表示，这些公司不应该涉足审查业务。

sentences.en: So in Facebook's telling, there is a problem of vaccine misinformation on the platform.
sentences.zh: 所以在Facebook的说法中，平台上确实存在疫苗虚假信息的问题。

sentences.en: But they have taken concrete steps to remove a lot of it and to try to drown it out or overshadow
sentences.zh: 但他们已经采取了具体步骤来删除大部分信息，并试图用好信息和准确信息将其压制或掩盖，

sentences.en: it with good information and accurate information that leads Facebook users to go get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 从而引导Facebook用户去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Facebook points to its own data showing that less and less people on the platform are vaccine hesitant, and they are taking credit for that because of these efforts.
sentences.zh: 并且Facebook指出自己的数据显示，平台上对疫苗犹豫不决的人越来越少，他们将此归功于这些努力。

sentences.en: But the White House is still frustrated because they say that even though they're taking these
sentences.zh: 但白宫仍然感到沮丧，因为他们表示，尽管Facebook采取了这些

sentences.en: proactive offensive measures, the White House is still frustrated that they're not taking down
sentences.zh: 主动的进攻措施，白宫依然对他们没有删除

sentences.en: enough misinformation and that the public is still seeing way too much misinformation about the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 足够多的虚假信息感到不满，公众仍然看到了太多的疫苗虚假信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It sounds like the White House is frustrated that on any given day, you might see the juxtaposition on Facebook of a COVID toolbox saying, here's where to get your vaccine.
sentences.zh: 听起来白宫感到沮丧的是，在任何一天，你都可能会在Facebook上看到并存的画面：一个COVID工具箱说，去哪里接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And then a few moments later, you might scroll down to a post on Facebook full of misinformation or even lies about that very vaccine.
sentences.zh: 然后过一会儿，你往下滚动，就会看到一篇满是虚假信息甚至关于该疫苗谎言的Facebook帖子。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 正是如此，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's almost like Facebook is rowing upstream with all of these offensive efforts, but they're also creating the surge of the down current with all this disinformation.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像Facebook所有的进攻努力都在逆水行舟，但他们又通过所有这些虚假信息制造了逆流的巨浪。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Cecilia, at the end of the day, back to your original analysis that both sides are kind
sentences.zh: 西莉亚，说到底，回到你最初的分析，即双方都有点

sentences.en: of right and both sides are kind of wrong here, the White House and Facebook, who seems to be
sentences.zh: 对，双方也都有点错，白宫和Facebook，当我们思考Facebook、社交媒体和疫苗犹豫这个问题时，谁似乎

sentences.en: more right when we think about the question of Facebook, social media, and vaccine hesitancy?
sentences.zh: 更正确一些？

sentences.en: Well, I think the evidence is clear to anyone who has social media that misinformation exists.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于任何使用社交媒体的人来说，证据很明显，虚假信息确实存在。

sentences.en: It's so ubiquitous.
sentences.zh: 它无处不在。

sentences.en: Definitely, there have been efforts to take it down.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，人们一直在努力将其删除。

sentences.en: I also think, Michael, it's really important to understand that this is not just social
sentences.zh: 我也认为，迈克尔，非常重要的一点是要明白，这不仅仅是社交

sentences.en: media, that so much misinformation about coronavirus vaccines are also being spouted across cable television and other media platforMs.
sentences.zh: 媒体的问题，关于冠状病毒疫苗的大量虚假信息也在有线电视和其他媒体平台上大肆传播。

sentences.en: So there's a whole ecosystem to contend with, but there's plenty of blame to go around among the social media platforMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要面对的是整个生态系统，但在社交媒体平台之间，有很多责任可以归咎。

sentences.en: And I think for Facebook, which has by far the biggest scale, much bigger than Twitter,
sentences.zh: 我认为对于Facebook来说，它的规模迄今为止是最大的，远比Twitter大得多，

sentences.en: it is a place that rightfully should be a focus because if anybody has the resources to fight
sentences.zh: 它理应成为关注的焦点，因为如果有人有资源来打击

sentences.en: this, it's a company like Facebook with a $1 trillion valuation and $85 billion in revenue, and that have been fighting this and have experts on staff for years.
sentences.zh: 这一点，那就是像Facebook这样估值1万亿美元、营收850亿美元的公司，而且他们多年来一直在与此斗争，并拥有专业员工。

sentences.en: There's a very familiar ring to everything you just said, which is Facebook and its scale means that it has a responsibility to deal with misinformation.
sentences.zh: 你刚才所说的一切听起来非常耳熟，那就是Facebook及其规模意味着它有责任处理虚假信息。

sentences.en: It felt like we had that same conversation when it came to Russia's disinformation campaign in
sentences.zh: 感觉我们在2016年

sentences.en: 2016 using Facebook, or President Trump spreading misinformation on Facebook around the 2020 election, and then of course, Facebook's role in the January 6th riot at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 利用Facebook干预选举的俄罗斯虚假信息活动，或者特朗普总统在2020年大选前后在Facebook上散布虚假信息时，以及当然还有Facebook在1月6日国会山骚乱中扮演的角色时，都进行过同样的对话。

sentences.en: And I wonder if it's right to see vaccine misinformation as of a piece with those previous episodes,
sentences.zh: 我在想，把疫苗虚假信息看作是那些先前事件的一部分是否正确，

sentences.en: or if based on the fact that Facebook has changed since 2016, and is being more proactive in all the
sentences.zh: 还是说，基于Facebook自2016年以来已经发生了变化，并且在你刚才描述的各个方面都更加积极主动这一事实，

sentences.en: ways you just described, that it's possible that that history makes Facebook an easy target for the White
sentences.zh: 历史可能会使Facebook在面对白宫关于疫苗的施压时成为一个容易成为众矢之的的靶子，

sentences.en: House when it comes to vaccines in a way that may not be quite fair.
sentences.zh: 而这可能并不完全公平。

sentences.en: I mean, this is absolutely part of a pattern that has existed at Facebook for years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这绝对是Facebook多年来一直存在的模式的一部分。

sentences.en: But what's different here, Michael, is that COVID-19 and efforts to end the pandemic through
sentences.zh: 但不同之处在于，迈克尔，COVID-19以及通过

sentences.en: these vaccines have been a absolute priority, not just for the government, but also from within
sentences.zh: 这些疫苗结束大流行的努力，已经成为绝对的重中之重，不仅对政府而言，对

sentences.en: Facebook.
sentences.zh: Facebook内部也是如此。

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg has said that this is absolutely one of his top priorities, and they have stricter rules on COVID misinformation than any other pieces of content.
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格曾表示，这绝对是他的首要任务之一，并且他们对COVID虚假信息的规则比任何其他类型的内容都要严格。

sentences.en: And the stakes are so high.
sentences.zh: 而且利害关系太大了。

sentences.en: When we've seen Facebook struggle with misinformation related to election interference, false news around politics, it's been upsetting for users.
sentences.zh: 当我们看到Facebook艰难应对与选举干涉、政治假新闻相关的虚假信息时，用户会感到不安。

sentences.en: It's been frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这让人沮丧。

sentences.en: It's certainly caught the attention of Washington and lawmakers who are very angry at Facebook.
sentences.zh: 这当然引起了华盛顿和对Facebook非常愤怒的国会议员的注意。

sentences.en: But this is about life and death.
sentences.zh: 但这是生死攸关的事情。

sentences.en: I think the consequences here are so high when it comes to false information that is making people potentially not want to get the vaccine, that it feels like this deserves
sentences.zh: 我认为，当涉及可能导致人们不想接种疫苗的虚假信息时，其后果是如此严重，以至于这似乎比以往的事件值得

sentences.en: more attention than other episodes.
sentences.zh: 更多的关注。

sentences.en: Well, Cecilia, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，西莉亚，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Times reported that at the start of the pandemic, a group of data scientists at Facebook
sentences.zh: 周一，《泰晤士报》报道称，在大流行开始时，Facebook的一组数据科学家

sentences.en: asked executives for their resources to help measure misinformation about COVID-19 on the platform.
sentences.zh: 请求高管提供资源，以帮助衡量该平台上关于COVID-19的虚假信息。

sentences.en: That request was never approved.
sentences.zh: 该请求从未获得批准。

sentences.en: Meanwhile...
sentences.zh: 与此同时……

sentences.en: These platforms that Facebook are killing people...
sentences.zh: Facebook这样的平台在杀人……

sentences.en: Let me know precisely what I said.
sentences.zh: 让我明确知道我说了什么。

sentences.en: I'm glad you asked me that question.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你问我这个问题。

sentences.en: ...asked about his remark that companies like Facebook were killing people,
sentences.zh: ……当被问及他关于像Facebook这样的公司在杀人的言论时，

sentences.en: President Biden clarified his statement, saying that the biggest blame lay with the dozen Facebook users who spread the most misinformation.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统澄清了他的声明，称最大的责任在于传播最多虚假信息的十几名Facebook用户。

sentences.en: Facebook isn't killing people.
sentences.zh: Facebook没有杀人。

sentences.en: In the first ruling of its kind, a federal judge found that Indiana University can require that its students be vaccinated against COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 在一项同类首创的裁决中，一名联邦法官裁定印第安纳大学可以要求其学生接种COVID-19疫苗。

sentences.en: The case involved eight students who argued that the requirement violated their rights, in part because vaccines against COVID-19 have only been granted
sentences.zh: 该案涉及八名学生，他们辩称该要求侵犯了他们的权利，部分原因是COVID-19疫苗仅获得了

sentences.en: emergency authorization rather than full federal approval.
sentences.zh: 紧急使用授权，而未获得全面的联邦批准。

sentences.en: But the judge ruled that the students' individual interests must be weighed against the larger goal of ensuring the health of the university's entire student body.
sentences.zh: 但法官裁定，必须将学生的个人利益与确保全体学生健康的更大目标进行权衡。

sentences.en: And with the backing of the international community,
sentences.zh: 在国际社会的支下，

sentences.en: Haiti has announced a new prime minister in an attempt to resolve a battle over who should lead the country since the assassination of its president, Jovenel Moïse.
sentences.zh: 海地宣布了一位新总理，试图解决自总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺以来关于谁应领导国家的争端。

sentences.en: The new leader, Ariel Henry, had been named prime minister by
sentences.zh: 新领导人阿里尔·亨利曾被莫伊兹任命为总理，

sentences.en: Moïse, but had not yet been sworn in when Moïse was killed.
sentences.zh: 但在莫伊兹遇害时尚未宣誓就职。

sentences.en: He will replace Claude Joseph, who took control of Haiti's government immediately after Moïse's murder in what some Haitian lawmakers likened to a coup.
sentences.zh: 他将取代克劳德·约瑟夫。在莫伊兹遇刺后不久，约瑟夫接管了海地政府，一些海地议员将其比作一场政变。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。
